caption: \textbf{Toy data and shared marginals.} (A) A fixed subset of training samples on the $64\times64$ count grid. Orange identifies the requested components $\{c_1,c_5\}$, blue their marginal twin $\{c_3,c_7\}$, and grey the remaining components; colours use maximum posterior component responsibility. Each axial component has prior mass $0.245$ and each diagonal component $0.005$. (B) Exact normalized marginals of the equal-weight request and twin laws. Both coordinates share the same marginal, so a single overlay suffices. The two laws occupy different pairs of modes in two dimensions despite identical one-dimensional marginals.
